    Returns

        # Reshape x into points
        points = x.reshape(-1, 2)
        
        # Calculate pairwise distances
        distances = pdist(points)
        
        if len(distances) == 0:
            return 0
        
        # Minimize negative of min/max ratio (equivalent to maximizing ratio)
        min_dist = np.min(distances)
        max_dist = np.max(distances)
        
        if max_dist == 0:
            return 0
            
        # Return negative ratio to minimize (we want to maximize the ratio)
        # Add small epsilon to avoid division by zero
        return -min_dist / (max_dist + 1e-15)

        # Ensure points stay within [0,1] x [0,1] bounds
        points = x.reshape(-1, 2)
        # Return 0 when constraints are satisfied (points within bounds)
        return np.concatenate([
            points[:, 0],           # x coordinates >= 0
            1 - points[:, 0],       # x coordinates <= 1
            points[:, 1],           # y coordinates >= 0
            1 - points[:, 1]        # y coordinates <= 1
        ])

    best_ratio = -np.inf
    
    np.random.seed(42)

                initial_points[:, 0] /= max_x
                initial_points[:, 1] /= max_y
            initial_points += np.random.normal(0, 0.015, (16, 2))
